2609.08410.title: Compositional Multilingual and Behavioral Attribute Steering
2609.08410.paper_summary: This study examines the compositionality of steering vectors for language and behavioral control in large language models. Focusing on language, jailbreak, and conciseness, we investigate whether additive, training-free composition of attribute steering vectors can preserve the intended steering effect of each attribute, across four instruction-tuned models from two model families and two size scales. We find that single-attribute steering is reliable for all three attributes, but only within an appropriate combination of intervention layer and steering strength, with abstract behaviors (jailbreak, conciseness) favoring middle layers and language favoring earlier layers. We show that additive composition of two attribute vectors succeeds in steering both attributes simultaneously when each is injected at its own best-performing layer, and that this partially extends to three simultaneously composed attributes, addressing an inconsistency left open by prior work on training-free composition. We further analyze the geometric properties of these steering vectors, finding that they are approximately orthogonal in the residual stream, consistent with their compositional behavior.
2609.08410.paper_summary_zh: 這項研究考察了大型語言模型中用於語言和行為控制的引導向量的組合性。<lb/>專注於語言、越獄和簡潔性，我們調查了屬性引導向量的加性、無需訓練的組合是否能夠保持每個屬性的預期引導效果，這涉及來自兩個模型家族和兩個大小尺度的四個指令調整模型。<lb/>我們發現，單一屬性引導對所有三個屬性都是可靠的，但僅在適當的干預層和引導強度的組合內，抽象行為（越獄、簡潔性）偏好中層，而語言則偏好早期層。<lb/>我們展示了當每個屬性在其最佳表現層注入時，兩個屬性向量的加性組合成功地同時引導這兩個屬性，並且這部分擴展到三個同時組合的屬性，解決了之前關於無需訓練的組合所留下的矛盾。<lb/>我們進一步分析了這些引導向量的幾何特性，發現它們在殘差流中大約是正交的，這與它們的組合行為是一致的。
